description: This file implements the logic for constructing and validating payment paths (strands) in the XRPL ledger, including normalization, validation, and conversion of path elements into executable steps for payment processing. It handles both XRP and issued assets, including Multi-Party Tokens (MPT), and ensures path correctness and compliance with protocol rules.
